name: Fertility Clinic
source: Hong Kong, it's been a while since I've been here. I grimace at the mental image of my ex-husband. I had been planning on starting a family with my ex, but now, I'm 36. Been able to get over 200 successful pregnancies... Special fertility clinic.
translation: 香港，我已经好一阵子没来过这里了。脑海中浮现出前夫的模样，我不禁皱起了眉。我原本打算和前夫组建家庭，可如今我已经36岁了。据说这里已经促成了超过200例成功受孕……一家特殊的助孕诊所。
